svg.title: mob-02 Cart and pickup time (Customer Mobile App)
svg.desc: Two low-fidelity phone frames. A: the cart for order MH-0142 at Market Hall with removed ingredients, add-ons, VAT per rate (2.87 and 0.48) and a total of EUR 34.50. B: the pickup-time sheet at 12:04 showing minutes 12:15 to 12:27 taken, 12:28 first available, 12:31 selected with the cancellation deadline 12:16, and the payment choice. Numbered callouts 1 to 10.
